title: Console sign-in page offers "Sign in as dev admin" when email and password sign-in is off, and the server refuses it
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbPN5UYMnBaNJPJWfG

Filed by the `domain:ui#3` seat from the out-of-scope finding of #30299's card thread (os-dev-report 6655442656, live shot `ui-seat3/30299/after-2-login-after-signout.png` in the project files).

## Observed

- Under `os dev` with email and password turned off in Setup and Google configured, the console sign-in page (after PR #30413) correctly draws only "Continue with Google", but still draws the "Sign in as dev admin" chip.
- The chip signs in with email and password, which the server refuses (`EMAIL_PASSWORD_DISABLED`). `DevAdminRow` in the console `LoginPage` renders on `devSeedAdmin` alone.

## Wanted

- The chip is drawn only when `emailPassword.enabled` is not `false` in `/api/v1/auth/config` (the same answer `LoginForm` already reads).

## Serial

Lives in `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/**`, held by #30157 (`domain:ui#4`, PR #30243). Start after #30157 lands.

Blocked-by: #30157
Refs: #30299
Dedupe words: devSeedAdmin, DevAdminRow, dev admin chip, emailPassword.enabled
